In the movie Mewtwo Strikes Back & Mewtwo Strikes Back EVOLUTION, Giovanni gave Mewtwo some special Armor to help control its powers and restrain Mewtwo to Giovanni's whims. This appearance later got upgraded and ended up appearing in not just the movie but the TCG and even as a form in spin-off titles such as Pokémon GO
